headline: Commercial Roofing Foreman/Supervisor
workPreference: Warehouse & Fulfillment, Commercial Carpenter, Service Technician, Commercial Roofing
summary: Skilled tradesperson with experience in commercial roofing and supervisory responsibilities, offering a strong background in construction, maintenance, and building material installation. Known for fast learning, strong customer service skills, and willingness to travel for extended periods. Seeks a long-term, career-oriented position and is open to roles in warehouse, carpentry, and technical trade fields.
